title: A Cosmological BCFW Bridge and Its Canonical Geometry
summary: We build a BCFW-like recursion for cosmological correlators using the orthogonal Grassmannian. The key step is a bridge deformation that leaves all the Grassmannian constraints intact. The recursion relations are purely algebraic and avoid any spectral or radial integrals that usually appear in curved space. We obtain the gluon 4-point correlator using this bridge, producing two factorization poles, a total energy singularity coming from the three point building block, and a shifted energy singularity that emerges only after adding the two channels using recursion.
